text: “I cannot tell—I cannot remember. I met your mother. And I will never meet her again.” “Why?” “What do I know about Mr. Wildeve now? I won’t have wicked opinions passed on me by anybody. it was too humiliating to be asked if I had received any money from him, or encouraged him, or something of the sort—I don’t exactly know what!” “How could she have asked you that?” “She did.” “Then there must have been some meaning in it.
